title: Shaping the 2027-2030 strategic plan priorities
subtitle: Resident survey results, a Council prioritization exercise, and a closed session on litigation, an energy retrofit program and intergovernmental matters.
overview: Council held a special meeting to help shape the City's 2027-2030 Strategic Plan. In a strategic session in the Conestoga Room, Council heard a consultant's findings on what is shaping Kitchener's direction, themes from interviews with Council members, and additional survey results from 550 more residents.

Members of Council then took part in a prioritization exercise, choosing which themes to accelerate, which to advance with some actions, and which to maintain as they are. Staff compared Council's results with those of a resident panel. No decisions on the priorities were made at this meeting. Staff will combine the results into draft strategic priorities and report back to Council in November 2026.

This matters to residents because the strategic plan guides City spending and service decisions for the next Council term. Council also voted to hold a closed session after the strategic session {{vote:m1}}. The minutes list it as covering potential litigation, City-owned commercial and financial information, an energy retrofit program, and information supplied in confidence by another level of government.

decisions.detail: Council agreed to meet in closed session after the special meeting to consider legal, commercial and financial, intergovernmental and negotiation matters, including the energy retrofit program.
